paragraphs: Allocore sells software that runs government loan, grant and fraud programs, aimed at the largest and most complex of them. The company applies experience from the financial industry to modernize federal systems.

On the lending side, staff track application status and make decisions on simple and complex applications. On the grant side, applications are monitored and decided throughout the grantmaking process. Fraud protection technologies are applied so that applicants are validated. Delivery is cloud-native, with deployment options the company says can be adapted to a customer's requirements.

Case studies center on the Small Business Administration, including MySBA, a one-stop-shop platform powered by Allocore. The company reports disbursement times falling from over 105 days to under 18 days through that platform. Another case study covers the VetCert platform the SBA developed and launched. A Paycheck Protection Program system launched in May 2020 and enabled the origination of over 7 million PPP loans. An advisory board of former congressional leadership and senior federal financial operations experts guides the company.

quote.text: Trillions in Loans and Grants Processed.
